inspection: All 104 plugin dark/light images inspected in six contact sheets; app dark/light/system-font/18pt representatives in five sheets plus existing title-bar preview. Remaining app built-in themes are preserved as supplementary captures. Images are evidence, not golden acceptance assertions. Review fix round 1: all 24 corrected titlebar/window-tab owner captures and all 6 actual SSH-key form captures inspected in two additional sheets; strip context and separate window-tab region now visibly represented.
limitations: Buddy native-window visual baseline unavailable headlessly; user-run acceptance remains required. App BuddyIntegration/BuddyTestSupport behavior preserved; app-owned notification/status captures present.
Native focus/traffic lights/glass/window placement not proven by peerless rendering. Native boundaries remain user acceptance.
Plugin SDK fake icons are placeholders. Sample standalone fake SettingsPanelHost uses placeholder labels; bundled-plugin-sample app captures use real host.
Test-only recursive layout of real composite JList renderer children is necessary without a peer; production behavior unchanged.

Inherited SettingsDialogPreview first run discovered user-home history; no history-content image or user write; runtime stopped. Those outputs discarded. Final preview verifies isolated user.home/HISTFILE/XDG_CONFIG_HOME/APPDATA before startup.

Existing standalone CommandPalettePreview pane-query assertion expects 5 but receives 12 baseline rows; unchanged and excluded. Narrow owner fixture renders actual CommandPalette with controlled commands.
